title: Whether 22 fixed-outlet pressure reducing valves at the far end of a water company's trunk main will cut the districts' assessed leakage by the contracted reduction in 2027-28, when a paper mill's weekday shifts take the inlet pressures below the valves' settings for most of the working day, and how many find-and-fix gang-years must make up any shortfall
subdomain: asset-condition-maintenance (a water network's leakage as the standing condition of its mains, assessed district by district from night flows and pressures by FAVAD, and a pressure scheme's effect on it forecast before the valves are installed)
prompt_shape: a committed go or hold (whether the phase meets its contracted reduction) with the phase's forecast leakage, its reduction, the shortfall and the find-and-fix gang-years, beside a grid of the zone's twelve other districts' 2025-26 assessed leakage and the zone's 2025-26 system input, billed unmetered consumption and real losses, and a chart of the 22 Phase 3 districts

sources.origin: constructed for this task by task162/generator/build.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional English water company and its pressure management partner, in the layouts of a telemetry archive's hourly CSV export, network and property registers, a billing extract by supply point, an assessment export workbook, a valve schedule workbook, PDF method, contract and certificate documents and an e-mail; no real organisation's records or person is depicted.
